```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
breeding_site_locations <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breeding_site_locations)
```

```{r}
glimpse(breeding_site_locations)
```

```{r}
df_mika <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(df_mika))
```

```{r}
glimpse(df_mika)
```
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_site_locations |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```
```{r}
b_migration_site <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
spec(b_migration_site)
```


```{r}
b_migration_site <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")

b_migration_selected <- b_migration_site |>
  select("winterLongtitude", "winterLatitude", "pslon", "pslat", "iblon", "iblat", "awestlon", "awestlat") |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(winterLongtitude = Winter_Longitude, winterLatitude = Winter_Latitude, pslon = Stopover_Longitude, pslat = Stopover_Latitude, iblon = Iberian_Longitude, iblat = Iberian_Latitude, awestlon = Westmost_Longitude, awestlat = Westmost_Latitude)

gt(b_migration_selected)  
```
